build_categorical_dist_qlearning: build distributional Q-learning targets for categorical value distributions over atoms using softmax cross-entropy loss
build_categorical_dist_double_qlearning: build distributional double Q-learning targets that decouple action selection from value estimation using a separate selector network
build_categorical_dist_td_learning: build distributional TD-learning targets for state-value distributions projected onto a fixed atom support
build_slice_with_actions: build a sparse tensor operation to slice batched embeddings by action indices using boolean masking
build_dist_value_extra: build a namedtuple holding the computed target distribution for regressing Q-value logits toward distributional targets
